video_title: Can ANYONE EVER pass Russell Westbrook as the GREATEST Thunder ever?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's unique achievement of averaging triple-doubles as a guard
quotes.excerpt: You can't name me a guy that's averaged triple-doubles as a guard four different years.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You can't name me a guy that's averaged triple-doubles as a guard four different years.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I didn't know he won two scoring titles.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's loyalty to Oklahoma City despite Kevin Durant's departure
quotes.excerpt: The man came out, stayed loyal to Oklahoma City, stayed down, took his team to the playoffs.
quotes.quote: The year he won MVP, think about all the chatter of Kevin Durant leaving. All the negativity that came from there, that Kevin Durant didn't want to play with him. The man came out, stayed loyal to Oklahoma City, stayed down, took his team to the playoffs, won MVP, averaged a triple-double that year, and took his team, showed that he's a number one. Proved it on the highest level.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of winning an NBA championship as a primary player
quotes.excerpt: These greats that just don't have rings, but they didn't win. That's what they're going to say.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: But do you think, that's just how it's crazy. That sounds insane. Who's ever done that? These greats that just don't have rings, but they didn't win. That's what they're going to say. But he didn't win. There's people always going to find the negative about a player. Well, he didn't win.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: Well, technically, winning consists of a team. He's been on good, great teams, he just didn't win.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook remains the greatest Oklahoma City Thunder player ever
quotes.excerpt: Greatest Oklahoma City Thunder player right now is who? Russell Westbrook.
quotes.quote: Greatest Oklahoma City Thunder player right now is who? Russell Westbrook. Who gets a statue first? Russell Westbrook. I mean that's clear, the nigga still playing.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook will eventually receive a statue in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: Now that he's retired, I guarantee you, may not happen this season, but in May, he gets a statue.
quotes.quote: Now that he's retired, I guarantee you, may not happen this season, but in May, he gets a statue. Next season, a retired jersey and a statue.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook built the winning culture in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: He built that. There was no team in Oklahoma City, Russell built that.
quotes.quote: What Russell did in Oklahoma City, you got to understand, he built that. There was no team in Oklahoma City, Russell built that. He built the winning culture, he stayed, stayed loyal, stayed down with the fans. Russell Westbrook would be the all-time favorite Thunder player ever.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Kawhi Leonard's tenure to Russell Westbrook's legacy
quotes.excerpt: The way he did it after Kevin Durant left made them love him more.
quotes.quote: I said Kawhi is in front of this, you said no. But the way he did it after Kevin Durant left made them love him more. And he stayed, and he won an MVP, he kept Oklahoma City on the map.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's impact on the Thunder organization
quotes.excerpt: Shai has been in there for like six years.
quotes.quote: Shai has been in there for like six years. He's been a year, yeah. He's been six in the bubble.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: The only reason to rank players over Russell Westbrook is championships
quotes.excerpt: The only reason is a chip. It's the only reason.
quotes.quote: The only reason is a chip. It's the only reason. Why? Watch this. Why?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Russell Westbrook to other Thunder greats
quotes.excerpt: We're going to go to Oklahoma City and we're going to talk to the fans.
quotes.quote: We're going to go to Oklahoma City and we're going to talk to the fans and ask them who's the all-time Thunder player. And they're going to say Russell. I'm just telling you.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's two MVP awards versus other players
quotes.excerpt: He's got two, not one. He's got two, back-to-back, and he got the chip.
quotes.quote: He's got two, not one. He's got two, back-to-back, and he got the chip.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: The die-hard Thunder fans' perspective on their greatest player
quotes.excerpt: You got to ask the die-hard Thunder fans who's the all-time Thunder.
quotes.quote: You got to ask the die-hard Thunder fans who's the all-time Thunder. And they're going to say Russell. I'm just telling you.

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook's impact on the Oklahoma City franchise
quotes.excerpt: He kept Oklahoma City on the map.
quotes.quote: He kept Oklahoma City on the map.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant's standing in the Thunder organization
quotes.excerpt: So Kevin Durant is third? Is that what I'm hearing?
quotes.quote: So Kevin Durant is third? Is that what I'm hearing?

quotes.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
quotes.summary_phrase: Nick Collison's legacy in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: Oh no, Sean Collison, Kevin Durant, Nick Collison.
quotes.quote: Oh no, Sean Collison, Kevin Durant, Nick Collison.

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's potential legacy if he stays in Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: Do you think if Shai spends the rest of his career, there's another 15 years, you don't think it changes?
quotes.quote: Do you think if Shai spends the rest of his career, there's another 15 years, you don't think it changes?

quotes.speaker: Raymond Felton
quotes.summary_phrase: Russell Westbrook as the first active player to receive a statue
quotes.excerpt: He might be the first player to have a statue like still playing.
quotes.quote: He might be the first player to have a statue like still playing.

quotes.summary_phrase: Kobe Bryant's championship legacy compared to other players
quotes.excerpt: Nigga, Kobe won five. I know. And Jordan won six.
quotes.quote: Nigga, Kobe won five. I know. And Jordan won six.
